content_sections.heading: About MGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is located at Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala - 686 560, and its letterhead states that it was established by the Kerala State Legislature by Notification No. 3431/Leg. C1/85/Law, dated 17th April 1985. According to the notice, the University is implementing integrated undergraduate programmes and strengthening advanced and interdisciplinary research in the Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences. The University had earlier invited applications for Assistant Professor through notifications 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A 2(3) dated 01.11.2025, 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A 2 dated 28.11.2025 (extension of time for submission of applications) and 67435/AD A2-1/2024/AD A 2(PART-1)(1) dated 27.02.2026. To ensure wider participation of eligible and academically qualified candidates, the recruitment has now been re-notified.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The re-notification lists 18 Assistant Professor posts, one in each row, with the reservation that applies to each post. Notes printed with the table: * Reserved for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in Open Competition (OC) category as per G.O.(P) No.14/2020/P&ARD dated 23/10/2020. ** Lien vacancy. *** Re-notification. For a post reserved for a particular community or group of communities, only persons belonging to that community or group may apply. Natives of States other than Kerala State are not eligible to apply for a post notified exclusively under the community reservation quota. OC-EWS (Economically Weaker Sections): in the absence of eligible candidates from the OC-EWS category, candidates from OC (Open Competition) will be considered. Hence, OC candidates are also eligible to submit an application for that post. Appointments will be made as per UGC Regulations, 2018 and the Reservation Principles in accordance with the Mahatma Gandhi University Statutes, 1997, the Kerala State & Subordinate Service Rules and the Kerala Service Rules.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Qualifications are as per UGC Regulations, 2018. The notice prints the following qualification for the Assistant Professor posts: Option A OR Option B The Ph.D. degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai). Applicants who have obtained degrees from Universities/Institutions outside the State of Keralam must submit an equivalence certificate/certificate of eligibility issued by Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam. Applicants who earn additional qualifications may submit them as hard copy before the last date of submission. The notice does not mention any teaching or research experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: The age limit for all Assistant Professor posts is not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice does not mention allowances, the nature of appointment or a probation period. It states that appointments will be made as per UGC Regulations, 2018 and the reservation principles of the Mahatma Gandhi University Statutes, 1997, the Kerala State & Subordinate Service Rules and the Kerala Service Rules, and that appointments shall be subject to the final judgement of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP(Civil) No. 20803/2022. The History or Sociology post (Sl. No. 18) is a lien vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The registration fee must be remitted only through online payment, using the facility provided in the online application form. A copy of the payment receipt must be submitted along with the hard copy of the online application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the online application through the link on the Mahatma Gandhi University website www.www.mgu.ac.in from 18 November 2026 onwards, on or before 17 December 2026. Pay the registration fee online through the facility provided in the online application form. Prepare two hard copies of the duly completed online application. Attach self-attested true copies of all certificates and documents in proof of qualification, age, community, reservation (if any), experience, NOC, equivalency and eligibility, along with the copy of the fee receipt. Send the hard copies to: Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.), Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O, Kottayam-686 560. They must reach this office on or before 31 December 2026. Teachers working in private colleges under the direct payment system must have their applications forwarded by the Principal to the respective Zonal Deputy Director of Collegiate Education, who will forward them to the University. The notice asks candidates to submit the online application early enough that the hard copy reaches the University well within the time limit. Late and defective applications will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Two hard copies of the duly completed online application Self-attested true copies of certificates in proof of qualification, age, community, reservation (if any), experience and eligibility Copy of the online registration fee receipt Caste Certificate/Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued after 17.12.2025 (applicants for posts under community reservation quota) Relevant EWS certificate/documents issued by the competent Revenue Authority (candidates claiming EWS reservation; to be uploaded with the application) Disability Certificate issued by the Competent Authority (candidates claiming Differently Abled reservation) No Objection Certificate from the employer (applicants working in Universities/Government/Aided Colleges etc.) Equivalence certificate/certificate of eligibility issued by Mahatma Gandhi University (degrees from Universities/Institutions outside Keralam)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam has re-notified 18 Assistant Professor posts across nine Schools, one post in each listed row.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 17 December 2026, and two hard copies must reach the Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.) by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MGU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: As per UGC Regulations, 2018: a Master's degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject plus NET/SLET/SET (with Ph.D. exemptions), or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 by QS, THE or ARWU.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MGU Assistant Professor 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026, with usual relaxation as per rules and 3 years' relaxation for regular teachers presently employed in Universities, Aided and Government Colleges in Keralam.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an MGU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The post is in Academic Level 10 with a Rationalised Entry pay of ₹57,700/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The registration fee is ₹2000/-, and ₹1000/- for SC/ST candidates, payable only online through the online application form.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MGU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.facultyrecruitment.mgu.ac.in by 17 December 2026, then send two hard copies with self-attested certificates and the fee receipt to the Deputy Registrar-II (Admn.), Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarsini Hills P.O, Kottayam-686 560, to reach by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied under the earlier notifications need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Those who applied under the notifications dated 01.11.2025, 28.11.2025 and 27.02.2026 need not apply again, and may submit additional qualifications as hard copy before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Can OC candidates apply for the OC/EWS Physics post?
faq.answer: Yes. If no eligible OC-EWS candidate is available, OC (Open Competition) candidates will be considered, so OC candidates may also apply for that post.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for community-reserved posts?
faq.answer: No. Natives of States other than Kerala State are not eligible for posts notified exclusively under the community reservation quota.
